name: Logo
description: Logo atom — the Digitaltableteur mark by default (monochrome currentColor, square footprint, optional controlled pulse), or any custom PNG/JPEG/SVG logo via src.

ariaRequirements: accessible name via title unless decorative
a11y.reviewedNote: Verified 2026-06-02: role=img/aria-label vs aria-hidden when decorative, focusable=false, non-interactive (no keyboard contract — wrap in link/button to activate). Every mark uses fill=currentColor → maps to system CanvasText in forced colors; the ForcedColors story passes axe. Pulse is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. All Logo tests pass. Re-verified 2026-07-13 for stable promotion: AT snapshots committed for all required stories; `animated` is now a controlled signal (pulses while true) rather than self-hover, driven by SiteHeader's link-hover state. Swapped into SiteHeader (production consumer on every page) with byte-for-byte parity vs the prior inline mark — identical viewBox 0 0 395 323, geometry, dt-logo-pulse keyframes, badge scale, currentColor tokens; verified live in the running app (rest/hover/both themes). Extended 2026-07-22 (content-atom elevation): custom-image path (`src`) renders a native — accessible name from `title` via alt, decorative maps to alt="" + aria-hidden; animated/badge stay built-in-mark-only so no motion applies to custom images. 2026-07-22: `badge` renamed to `background` (same lime-circle rendering; prop name now says what it does) before the first npm publish of the Logo export, so no published React API breaks.

src.description:
Optional image URL (PNG, JPEG, or SVG) rendered instead of the built-in
Digitaltableteur mark. `title` becomes the alt text; `animated` and
`background` apply to the built-in mark only and are ignored when `src` is
set.

size.description: Square render box in pixels. Default 24.

animated.description:
Pulse the three leading bars while true; a controlled signal driven from the
consumer's hover/focus state (respects prefers-reduced-motion). Default false.

background.description:
Render the brand lime circle background behind a contrast mark
(`--logo-background` / `--logo-color`). Default false.

title.description: Accessible name for the mark. Ignored when `decorative`. Default "Digitaltableteur".

decorative.description: When true the mark is purely decorative and removed from the accessibility tree. Default false.

dense: Logo atom: built-in DT mark (monochrome currentColor, square footprint) or custom image via src; optional link wrapper

usage.description: The logo atom. Renders the Digitaltableteur mark by default — monochrome via currentColor so it inherits the surface's ink, square footprint, optionally wraps itself in a home link. Pass src to render any custom logo image (PNG, JPEG, or SVG) inside the same square box.
